data.shortfall_policy: report insufficient evidence; do not claim new default accepted

metrics.recall20: Fraction of gold passage IDs found among evidence attached to the first20 primary claims, with passage IDs deduplicated. Auxiliary bridge claims are excluded. Compute all arms afresh; do not directly reuse old passage-ranking metrics.
metrics.chain_primary_complete: All annotated required evidence present in primary top20 claims; method does not need graph metadata to receive credit.
metrics.chain_context_complete: All annotated evidence within shared context budget including separately counted auxiliary support; secondary metric only.
metrics.statistics: paired bootstrap by independent chain/source group,95% interval; no optional stopping or post-holdout retuning

gates.rule: All deterministic cases pass; intended budget-fitting promotions actually appear in reranker input; no resource limit breached
All recoverable graph failures match T40 under permissive policy; strict mode errors; fatal integrity/cancellation never swallowed
On new two-hop stratum, G2 primary EvidenceRecall@20 >= T48+0.05 and G1+0.05; both paired95% interval lower bounds>0
On ordinary stratum G2-L and G2-T48 point differences>=-0.01, paired95% lower bounds>=-0.02; zero critical definition/condition/negation regressions
Every claimed complete path has all valid edge sources, no reviewed/pending leakage, no transitive inference represented as author fact
No anchor => graph skipped; no new irrelevant primary graph evidence or unsupported path conclusion on independently annotated hard/ambiguous/out-of-domain negatives
Warm end-to-end p95<=1.25*L and6000ms; graph p95<=50ms; RSS<=2GiB;cold<=12s;reranker input<=48
Fresh offline extracted package passes actual JS/CLI/MCP queries and follow-up with matched hashes
